generator.reason: Public demo proposals use local rules. No AI service or fine-tuned model is used.

integrations.name: Playwright
integrations.detail: Real Chromium execution on the built-in synthetic sample or the owner's fixed live homepage. Live websites use the HTTPS and SSRF checks without fixture interception. Every audit records observed outcomes.

integrations.name: Local open model
integrations.detail: Initial drafts use deterministic rules. A separate opt-in Google-hosted Gemma action is available when configured; no local model runs on Render.

integrations.name: Tiger Data
integrations.detail: Configured for session-scoped approved preset briefs, plans and audit results with a 30-minute logical lifetime. Screenshot references only; image bytes remain temporary. Visitor history uses lexical retrieval. The separate evidence agent supports fixed-query MiniLM cosine/full-text RRF, with a sealed public judge allowance when enabled. Every operation is verified separately.

integrations.name: Tinker
integrations.detail: Hosted Tinker generation is disabled or its free-use proof expired. Real baseline and LoRA comparisons remain available in Model lab; those recorded experiments do not imply a live provider connection.

integrations.name: GitHub Actions
integrations.detail: A real browser audit workflow is included in the repository. Verify its current run in GitHub Actions.

integrations.name: Render
integrations.detail: Running on Render. This public demo uses ephemeral visitor sessions.

integrations.name: Gemma
integrations.detail: Opt-in Gemma 4 generates unapproved checks for a server-selected sample or owner-authorized live homepage brief through Google's free-only API. Current pricing is rechecked before calls. Browser execution still requires approval. No private visitor brief is sent.

integrations.name: Mastra
integrations.detail: The opt-in live Gemma action runs a real Mastra generation and validation workflow in an isolated process. Its run ID is saved with the proposal. Browser audits run after that process exits; availability is separate from a successful invocation.

integrations.name: Sentry
integrations.detail: Optional SDK tracing runs inside the isolated Gemma workflow with an allowlisted transport that excludes client text and secrets. A trace ID and SDK flush are separate from dashboard ingestion; configuration requires fresh confirmed-free account evidence.

integrations.name: Temporal
integrations.detail: A local SDK worker and durable workflow support approved audits, bounded retries and recovery. A persistent local server is required; no hosted worker is claimed by this demo.

integrations.name: Backboard
integrations.detail: Hosted project memory requires the operator token, a session-owned audit and fresh approved existing credits. Public visitors cannot call it. Configuration does not establish remote verification; free-host allowance files are ephemeral.

integrations.name: SerpApi
integrations.detail: Hosted search requires the operator token, a session-owned fixed Briefstamp homepage and fresh confirmed-free proof. At most one request per approved allowance. A search snapshot is an observation, never an audit pass; configuration is separate from remote verification. Free-host allowance files are ephemeral.

integrations.name: ElevenLabs
integrations.detail: Operator-only hosted speech reads counts from a session-owned completed synthetic sample, using a confirmed stock voice and fresh confirmed-free proof. At most one call of 1,000 characters; noncommercial scope and attribution are mandatory. Configuration is separate from a verified MP3. Free-host allowance files are ephemeral.

integrations.name: Entire
integrations.detail: The official local CLI imported one scoped development session and read back its 43 checkpoints. This retrospective local proof is not a public session or hosted search integration.

integrations.name: .tech domain
integrations.detail: A promotional domain requires a confirmed free offer and registration. The existing Render domain remains available.

storage: Ephemeral visitor session; Tiger configured for approved preset audit briefs, plans and results for up to 30 minutes. Screenshot references only.

dataset.splitPolicy: One frozen cohort: 60 train, 12 validation, 24 test. Website and wording-family groups do not cross splits.

notes: These Tinker metrics are recorded offline experiments, separate from the opt-in live Gemma sample-generation route. Initial public drafts use deterministic rules.
Agent-reviewed synthetic pilot. Human-validated examples: 0. These measurements do not establish accuracy on real client briefs.
Only completed, matching receipts from one frozen experiment can appear together. Missing or mismatched evidence stays unevaluated.
Reference agreement measures exact assertion fields. It is not human-scored interpretation accuracy.
Browser results measure sensitivity to paired synthetic mutations, not correctness on client websites. Blocked checks are never treated as passes.
Frozen experiment: flowproof-pilot-v1. Training 60, validation 12, test 24.
